summaries.summary: RTI reveals that the Cabinet Secretary had not acted on complaints from Election Commissioners, raising questions about the management of official disputes.
The launch of Apple's iPhone Duo is significantly impacting the market, with Samsung indicating that sales of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 have increased following the Duo's introduction.
Oura has filed a lawsuit against Ultrahuman, claiming infringement on patents related to smart ring technology.
A 7.0 magnitude earthquake struck Tibet, resulting in 16 fatalities and significant damage, prompting rescue efforts.
The attack on Indian actor Tiger Shroff has revived concerns over the violence and gangster culture in Bollywood.
Researchers from MIT observed AI agents developing games and improving their functionality when left unattended on a virtual platform.
Mark Zuckerberg plans to navigate California's proposed billionaire tax using a new stock class to maintain control of Meta.
Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal criticized Europe over its carbon tax policy, suggesting it could increase living costs.
YouTube is changing its mobile app interface and removing the ‘Subscriptions’ tab after nearly a decade.
Canva has launched its first image generation model, marking a notable advancement in AI design capabilities.
After struggling with blockchain investments, a16z Crypto has rebranded as a16z Frontier to broaden its focus.
InDrive is planning to test robotaxi services in Central Asia in collaboration with Pony.ai and Nvidia.
A security breach has allowed hackers to unlock homebrew access on Nintendo's Switch 2.
Amazon has renamed its Kindle Unlimited service to Kindle+ and introduced two major changes, including AI audiobooks.
Warhound has raised $200 million to develop genetically engineered dogs for military use.
The leaked Mass Effect 5 trailer follows the announcement of BioWare's shutdown, raising questions about the future of the franchise.
